title: Notebook Plugin
description: A Portable Notebook Plugin created by ElMarcels
body:
# NOTEBOOK PLUGIN BY ElMarcels
---
This plugin is very simple; it's a portable notebook. Simply running /notebook gives you a notebook icon labeled "(USER)'s Notebook." The best part is that it doesn't matter if you lose the notebook or accidentally delete it; just running /notebook again restores your notebook with everything you wrote! In other words, it saves it automatically.
